title: cDNA Synthesis
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science

steps_raw.instruction: Scope and Applicability: Covers the synthesis of first-strand cDNA from total RNA using the Invitrogen SuperScript III Reverse Transcriptase system.
Invitrogen Superscript III First-Strand Synthesis System (Invitrogen 18080-051) at
Anchored dT (5 µg/µl)
Total RNA (~5 µg) at -20ºC
Nuclease-Free Water (Ambion AM9932 or equivalent)
1.7 ml microcentrifuge tubes
96-well PCR Plate (Eppendorf 951020401)
Rainin Single Pipette: p10, p20, p200
Rainin 12-channel p20
Rainin Electronic Single Repeater p200
Filter tips: p20, p200
Benchtop Centrifuge (5810 R or equivalent)
Thermal cycler (MJ or Bio-Rad)
cDNA for QC and downstream processes such as “PCR from cDNA for IVT Reactions”.
MB0004 2100 Bioanalyzer Operation for PCR, GTP, and IVT Products
https://www.protocols.io/view/2100-bioanalyzer-operation-for-pcr-gtp-and-ivt-pro-bfzjjp4n
MB0050 PCR Prep from cDNA for IVT Reactions
https://www.protocols.io/view/pcr-prep-from-cdna-for-ivt-reactions-bep7jdrn/abstract
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.

Methodology/Procedures: NOTE: unless otherwise noted, ‘spin down’ means to spin the tubes in a microcentrifuge for 5-10” at top speed (or plates in the benchtop centrifuge for 2’ at 1800rpm) in order to drive the liquid to the bottom of the tube/wells.
Pull out Invitrogen SuperScript III First-Strand Synthesis kit from -20ºC:
Thaw at RT for 15’: Anchored dT, 10 mM dNTP mix, NFdH20, 10x RT Buffer, 25 mM MgCl2, 0.1 M DTT
Place in benchtop cooler: RNase OUT, SuperScript III RT
Thaw RNA aliquot at RT for 10’ (RNA information can be found on the cDNA worksheet in the upper right highlighted in yellow)
Once thawed, vortex and spin down all reagents except flick to mix RNase OUT, SuperScript III RT and RNA aliquot. Spin down all reagents.
Label a PCR plate with the cDNA plate name listed at the top of the paperwork. It will have the format: cDNA_YYMMDD_PP, where YY=year, MM=month, DD=day, PP=plate#.

Label a 1.7 ml tube as “cDNA Syn Premix”; this will be your cDNA Synthesis Premix tube. Label 1.7 ml tubes as “01”, “02”, “03”, etc. for each RNA+Primer Premix. Consult with the paperwork to determine how many premix tubes are needed.
Preparing the RNA+Primer Premix:
Follow the table for preparing the RNA+Primer Premix on the cDNA worksheet. Volume of each component is calculated based on the entries in cDNA tab and includes waste volume.
Make up the RNA+Primer Premix in the corresponding labeled tube.
Add the components listed in the premix table in order- nuclease free water, anchored dT, then Total RNA.
Use the p200 repeater pipette with filter tips to aliquot premixes into the labeled PCR plate according to plate map.
Preheat the thermalcycler to 65ºC. Choose the program for 65ºC for 10’.
Spin down and incubate the plate for 5 minutes at 65ºC.
After incubation, immediately place the plate in the benchtop cooler for 1’.
Prepare cDNA Synthesis Premix:
While the RNA+Primer Plate is incubating, prepare the cDNA Synthesis Premix:
Spin down each reagent.

Follow the table for preparing the cDNA Synthesis Premix on the cDNA worksheet. Volume of each component is calculated based on the entries in cDNA tab and includes waste volume Add reagents in the order listed in the table:
Flick to mix ten times.
Add 10 µl of the cDNA Synthesis Premix to each well containing the RNA+Primer premix using the 12-channel p20 with filter tips. Change tips between each row.
Mix by pipetting 3-4 times and spin down.
Incubate cDNA plate in thermalcycler on preset program “cDNA-dT”. The reaction will run as follows:
Remove plate from the thermalcycler and spin down.
Run samples on the Bioanalyzer using the mRNA Nano program. Refer to MB0004 2100 Bioanalyzer Operation for PCR, GTP, IVT Products.
DO NOT denature samples.
Determine that all duplicate samples show alike traces.
After confirming duplicate samples are alike, the duplicate samples can be pooled into 1.7 ml tubes—different 1.7 ml tubes for each premix.
Label tubes as: “cDNA_YYMMDD_PP_WW-WW”, where YY=year, MM=month, DD=day, PP=plate#, WW=wells
Reassemble Invitrogen SuperScript III First-Strand Synthesis System by replacing all tubes that were removed from the box.
Store samples at -20ºC in box labeled “cDNA”.
Paste BA traces in documentation
